name: Acid line
notes: A 303-style saw line: resonant filter sweep, accent from the filter envelope and a little drive and delay.
code:
setcpm(126/4)

acid: note("c2(5,8) [~ c3] eb2 [c2 g1]").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(300, 1800).slow(8)).lpq(12).lpenv(2).lpdecay(0.12).lpsustain(0).decay(0.2).sustain(0).distort(0.4).gain(0.6).delay(0.25).delaytime(0.36).delayfeedback(0.4)
